routes.currentBehavior: Drops original query before forwarding. Preserves upstream body/status, filters upstream headers and adds no-store. Direct Staff leaf validates filters and scopes its repository reads.

Game-scoped progress lookup resolves the contract before forwarding. Approval subsequently invokes the existing local atomic reward RPC. This two-step sequence is not one transaction; reward failure can follow a successful review.
Normalizes accepted to approve and merges feedback into resultPayload. Does not automatically issue rewards.
Normalizes the request without automatic reward. Staff leaf records approve/reject/request_revision transitions, denies forged Staff authority and rejects review after reward issuance.

Local intercept, not Classroom HTTP. One authoritative RPC per attempt with URL game/contract/progress, server Staff and x-request-id, followed by scoped reads. Body-supplied reward/actor authority is ignored; applied/replayed receipts are preserved.

Forwards body and retry headers. Staff leaf checks ownership and active Player before credential replacement through set_player_identity_and_access_credential_v2. Identifier-only writes do not revoke sessions.

proofBoundary.fixtureLevel: Actual request/handler code with synthetic dependencies. Root auth-provider failure and leaf injected auth failure are distinct evidence classes, not live session-expiry/revocation tests.
proofBoundary.rewardReplay: Adapter invocation counts and synthetic applied/replayed receipts do not establish SQL locking, conservation, race safety or transaction replay. Preserve the single existing RPC; never substitute the older direct Staff reward-then-mark implementation.
proofBoundary.credentialReplay: Neither x-request-id nor idempotency-key is forwarded as a credential RPC parameter. Repeated or changed payload behavior is characterized rather than relabeled idempotent.
proofBoundary.noNormalization: No identity/error/order/monetary/currency/effect field is scrubbed. Contract clocks and credential material are injected; the non-injectable identifier-only updated_at is checked against its execution interval.
proofBoundary.downstreamUse: Future adapter refactors must retain these observations or separately authorize corrections. No deletion, external-consumer clearance, runtime certification or later REF task implementation is granted.
